title: Chromosome 7 — band assembly and 7q22.1
clinical_history: Reconstruct chromosome 7 from G-band segments, then identify the highlighted locus. Sub-bands of 7q22 are included so that 7q22.1 can be named completely.
hints: 7q22.1 means chromosome 7, q arm, region 2, band 2, sub-band 1.
q22.1 is the most proximal of the 7q22 sub-bands (closest to the centromere among 7q22.1–7q22.3).
After the centromere, q11 comes before q21, then q22, then q31 toward qter.
explanation: Cytogenetic addresses are hierarchical, not arbitrary strings. 7q22.1 is nested inside 7q22, which is nested inside region 7q2 on the long arm of chromosome 7.
plain_language_interpretation: Normal chromosome 7 assembled at band/sub-band resolution, with 7q22.1 as the highlighted locus.
